_doc: Retired Equihash pools. Only entries with a citable source. Dates are as stated by the source.

pools.name: Flypool (Zcash)
pools.reason: Pool closed; operator announced the shutdown without giving a public reason.
pools.notes: Flypool was historically one of the largest ZEC pools (a 2018 community thread discusses its network share).

sources.label: r/zec: 'Why is Zcash Flypool shutting down?' (Aug 2022)
Zcash Community Forum: Flypool/Bitfly miner centralization (2018)

pools.name: Slush Pool (Zcash)
pools.reason: Slush Pool discontinued Zcash mining before rebranding to Braiins Pool.

sources.label: Stacker News: 'Slush Pool discontinues Z Cash mining'
Zcash Community Forum: Slush Pool [official] thread

pools.name: 2Miners (Horizen)
pools.reason: Horizen ended proof-of-work and migrated ZEN to Base; pool shut down before the final block (1,807,300).

pools.name: F2Pool (Horizen + ZEN/ZEC switching)
pools.reason: ZEN pool and ZEN/ZEC profit-switching pool terminated ahead of the Horizen PoW end; hashrate moved to the ZEC pool.

sources.label: F2Pool help center: ZEN mining service ending soon

pools.name: Poolin (Horizen)
pools.reason: ZEN no longer produces PoW blocks; Poolin switched connected miners to ZEC.

sources.label: Poolin help center: Poolin will no longer support ZEN mining

pools.name: 2Miners (Flux)
pools.reason: Flux replaced ZelHash (Equihash 125,4) PoW with PoUW v2 / Proof of Nodes at block 2,020,000; pools are no longer used.

sources.label: 2Miners blog: October 2025, the end of Flux mining
